item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"76648b1c4e345333b223-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"明確提供 WEP/WPA 金鑰破解工具與操作範例。","evidence":"aircrack-ng A 802.11 WEP / WPA-PSK key cracker"},{"decision_id":"acf3efd3dc211c6616aa-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"記載從擷取檔提取並儲存 WPA 四向交握的功能。","evidence":"save any 4-way handshakes to a new file"},{"decision_id":"c6776d1e2d952db07e36-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"介紹無線封包注入與重播，未說明 HTTP 分析工具的請求重送功能。","evidence":"aireplay-ng Inject packets into a wireless network to generate traffic"},{"decision_id":"015954fdb56103031471-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"說明定期連接埠掃描與逐步擴大掃描範圍的做法。","evidence":"You may want to start with simple port scanning, then move on to OS detection or version detection later as desired."},{"decision_id":"9855722c9149f32ea60c-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容是網路連接埠掃描與服務防護，未記載網頁應用程式漏洞掃描器。","evidence":"Next comes audit every open port available externally through the firewall or on the internal network."},{"decision_id":"c80d8f62590f46adf411-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"介紹鑑識磁碟映像處理與加密功能，未提供密碼雜湊格式辨識。","evidence":"The Advanced Forensic Format (AFF) is on-disk format for storing computer forensic information."},{"decision_id":"00827d7a6f90e7231bc6-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"僅教學開發瀏覽器漏洞模組，沒有選取、設定與執行模組的終端使用者流程。","evidence":"To get things started, you can always use the following template to start developing your browser exploit:"},{"decision_id":"55cff4a44f9813aafc9f-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"依此較廣規則，文章實質解說 Metasploit 漏洞模組及其開發機制，符合模組／漏洞利用主題。","evidence":"The Metasploit Framework provides different mixins you can use to develop a browser exploit"}]}
